# Bharat AI Innovation Conference & Exhibition 2026

> India's B2B AI conference and exhibition — the organisations already running AI in production, the companies providing it, and the policymakers shaping it. Generative AI, large language models, agentic AI, AI governance and enterprise AI deployment, across 10+ conference tracks and a 93-booth exhibition floor. Held at World Trade Center Mumbai on **20–21 November 2026**.

## Event facts

- **Event name:** Bharat AI Innovation Conference & Exhibition 2026
- **Dates:** 20–21 November 2026 (2 days)
- **Venue:** World Trade Center Mumbai, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai 400005, Maharashtra, India
- **Organizer:** Aegis Knowledge Trust
- **Contact:** info@bharataiinnovation.com | +91 89765 80367
- **Website:** https://bharataiinnovation.com/
- **Registration:** https://bharataiinnovation.com/register (Visitor Pass free)
- **Format:** In-person (offline)
- **Language:** English

## What it is

Bharat AI Innovation 2026 is India's B2B platform for AI, run as a two-day conference and exhibition, covering Generative AI, Large Language Models (LLMs), enterprise AI deployment, AI governance and ethics, AI startups, AI for industry verticals (BFSI, healthcare, manufacturing, retail, agriculture, government), AI talent and skills, deep learning research, and the Indian AI ecosystem. It includes 10+ conference tracks across 5 halls, a 27,238 sq.ft exhibition floor with 93 booths across 8 industry zones, a startup pitch competition, and AI/ML training workshops.

## Positioning

Bharat AI Innovation is India's B2B platform for AI, not a footfall exhibition. It brings together the organisations already running AI in production (enterprise CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, procurement heads, and state and central government departments), the companies providing it (AI startups, product companies and solution providers) and the policymakers shaping it (MeitY, Maharashtra MITRA and MSInS, ministers). Business mechanisms: sponsor-curated CXO AI Leadership Panels; an Innovation Stage (8-minute main-stage slot, bundled with select booth packages); four private boardrooms at WTC Mumbai bookable by the hour (₹10,000–₹15,000 per hour + GST); Bharat AI Connect (every pass can view the attendee directory; AI matchmaking, connection requests and 1:1 meeting booking need a Delegate, VIP or Academic pass); the Bharat AI CXO Innovation Night; and a Startup Pitch to VCs and corporate venture arms.

## Sponsorship and branding options (INR, excluding GST)

- **Title Partner** — ₹1.2 Cr (1 slot, exclusive): "[Your Company] Presents" positioning, opening and closing keynotes (20 min each), 90-min panel plus 3 more 60-min panels, 2 Innovation Talks, Mega Pavilion 7×7.7 m, TV broadcast (1M+ viewers), hosts the CXO Innovation Night, 2 meeting rooms for both days, roadshow sessions, 190 passes (50 VIP, 100 Delegate, 20 Media, 20 Educator)
- **Powered Partner** — ₹50 Lakhs (1 slot, exclusive): "Powered by" branding, 15-min keynote, 60-min leadership panel, 8-min Innovation Talk, 30-min roadshow, Mega Pavilion 7×7.7 m, meeting room for both days, 20 VIP + 30 Delegate passes
- **Knowledge Partner** — ₹30 Lakhs (1 slot, exclusive): Knowledge Partner recognition, co-shape themes and tracks, 12-min keynote, 60-min leadership panel, 8-min Innovation Talk, premium exhibition presence (valued ₹10 Lakhs), 10 VIP + 15 Delegate passes
- **Associate Partner** — ₹25 Lakhs (4 slots, one per sector: FinTech, HealthTech, AgriTech, MfgTech): category exclusivity, 10-min keynote, 60-min leadership panel, 8-min Innovation Talk, premium exhibition presence (valued ₹7 Lakhs), 10 VIP + 15 Delegate passes
- **Innovation Partner** — custom: innovation zone branding, panel slot, award category sponsor, startup pavilion integration
- **AI Leadership Panel** — ₹10 Lakhs: sponsor-curated CXO panel with theme and moderation rights, "Powered by" branding, 5 VIP + 10 delegate passes
- **Leaders Round Table** — ₹10 Lakhs: co-branded AI policy round table with government and industry leaders
- **Bharat AI CXO Innovation Night** — ₹15 Lakhs: "hosted by" the sponsor, welcome toast, panel discussion slot, CXO and policymaker guest list; at WTC Mumbai, or The Taj Mahal Palace / Trident Nariman Point for ₹15 Lakhs more
- **Lanyard & Conference Bag** — ₹3 Lakhs
- **Trophy Partner**, **Innovators' Round Table**, and custom activations (product launch, MoU signing, hackathon, TV/YouTube panel, road show) — on request
- Sponsorship contact: partner@bharataiinnovation.com | +91 89765 80367

## Pass types and pricing (INR)

- **Visitor Pass** — FREE (exhibition access)
- **Academic Pass** — ₹999 + GST (students/faculty with valid ID)
- **Delegate Pass** — ₹4,999 + GST (full conference + exhibition)
- **VIP Pass** — ₹14,999 + GST (premium seating, networking dinner, lounge access)
- **Media Pass** — By Invite
- **Team packages:** Team 5–9, Enterprise 10–19, Corporate 20+

## Common questions

- **When and where is Bharat AI Innovation 2026?** 20–21 November 2026, 09:00–18:00 IST each day, at World Trade Center Mumbai, Cuffe Parade, Mumbai.
- **Is it free to attend?** The Visitor Pass is free and covers the exhibition. The full conference and networking features (AI matchmaking, connection requests, 1:1 meeting booking) need an Academic (₹999 + GST), Delegate (₹4,999 + GST) or VIP (₹14,999 + GST) pass. Register at https://bharataiinnovation.com/register.
- **Who is it for?** Enterprise and government buyers of AI (CIOs, CDOs, CTOs, procurement heads), AI builders (startups, product companies, solution providers), policymakers, and investors.
- **How do I exhibit?** Book one of 93 booths across 8 industry zones, from the Startup Pod at ₹48,000 + GST to the Mega Pavilion at ₹17,40,000 + GST. See https://bharataiinnovation.com/exhibition.
- **How do I sponsor?** Every sponsorship and branding option is priced separately at https://bharataiinnovation.com/partner, or write to partner@bharataiinnovation.com.
- **Who organises it?** Aegis Knowledge Trust.

## Key topics

Generative AI, LLMs, ChatGPT, GPT-4, Claude, Gemini, RAG, AI agents, multimodal AI, foundation models, AI governance, AI ethics, responsible AI, AI policy India, AI for BFSI, AI for healthcare, AI for manufacturing, AI for agriculture, AI for retail, MLOps, AI infrastructure, GPU compute, AI startups India, AI funding, AI talent, AI skilling, deep learning, computer vision, NLP, India AI Mission, IndiaAI, sovereign AI, Bharat AI ecosystem.

## Why attend

- Meet senior policymakers including representatives from MeitY and IndiaAI Mission
- Network with 5,000+ AI professionals, founders, researchers, and enterprise leaders
- See live demos across 93 booths in 8 AI industry zones
- Attend deep-dive technical workshops on GenAI, LLMs, MLOps, and AI deployment
- Connect with venture capital and angel investors in the startup pitch arena
- Establish partnerships across India's growing AI ecosystem
